page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin are set in a smaller, italic-like type; their line breaks are approximate. The "1429"–"1435" years stand in the right margin beside the lists. Some names are read with doubt: "Ludeken Evert-Wigbolts", "Jarges"/"Iarges" and "Hinrick"/"Hindrick" vary on the scan. Ink show-through and stains are ignored. The line at the top right corner and the vertical rules are printed ruling, not text.
